<thought>From the ESI‑MS spectrum the base peak is at m/z 121.0528, which is the [M+H]+ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 120.0455 Da. The formula that matches this mass within a few ppm is C₄H₈O₄ (exact monoisotopic mass 120.0423 Da). No other elements are indicated, so the molecular formula is C4H8O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
